description: Build config of the release catalog v3 (scripts/build-catalog-v3.mjs, scripts/lib/catalog-batches.mjs). Layers in order: a later layer's card replaces an earlier one's in place; new cards append. The base layer (expansion.v1, real.v2.2) is frozen and listed expansion first to keep the card order of CATALOG_V3; the two share no card. Pipeline batches follow as { "kind": "batch", "id": "<issuer-slug>-<YYYY-MM>" } (files in evals/curation/batches/<id>/). Dropped cards carry their reason here until the pipeline state supplies it.

dropped.synchrony-phillips-66-credit-card: cents-per-gallon fuel rewards, not a rate on the purchase
dropped.synchrony-techron-advantage-visa: cents-per-gallon fuel rewards, not a rate on the purchase
